# Digital twin run — AI & automation wave 1

*Model: `TWIN-BASE-10B` v1.0 (2026-07) — Archetype IDN — $10B NPR, single-instance Epic on AWS, Snowflake EDW, Databricks lakehouse. Horizon 36 months. Generated by `twin.py`; do not hand-edit.*

> Eight-intervention automation portfolio across the cycle: auth submission and tracking, eligibility orchestration and coverage discovery, autonomous coding expansion, edit resolution, intelligent posting, denial/appeal AI, AR status bots, and a patient billing agent. Staffing capture is attrition-based and trails each capability by ~2 quarters.
